policy: Verbatim pinned C SPAWN/WAIT/GROUP/AT and property loader cases. SPAWN resets then resolves model identity; WAIT/GROUP reset all pending properties; bare AT preserves an empty queue row; AT copies then clears. Health overrides cascade by player count. Original binary32 coordinates and offline Q16 projection are paired in each validated row. Alias and model identity remain source-derived. Unknown directives, queued scripts/music and unbound properties fail explicitly.
numeric_scope: Authored MOTU queue coordinates are integral and exactly representable as Q16; general source floats retain binary32 bits and explicit projection metadata, not full live coordinate equivalence.
remaining: native producer and actual queue admission/control
post-constructor smartspawn alias/health/map/boss properties and events
live enemy/player counts, wait/group, scrolling and completion
